tuning_key.text: The rules I don't know but what's patently true is we all know nothing, we haven't a clue
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Every system you're in—every relationship, every rule, every expectation—is built on someone's guess. The ones who move are the ones who stop pretending they know and start listening to what's actually alive in front of them. Trust isn't belief in certainty; it's the steady pulse beneath the fear, the part of you that knows the difference between a borrowed answer and your own breath. That's what's real today.

practice.title: Unknowing
practice.instruction: Notice one thing you've been certain about in the last hour—a rule, a "should," a way things work—and let it soften into a question instead; don't answer it, just feel the shift.

practice.title: The Honest Pulse
practice.instruction: Place your hand on your chest or belly and find the steady rhythm beneath the noise—your heartbeat, your breath—and recognize that this aliveness doesn't need permission or a rulebook to keep going.

practice.title: Echo Anchor
practice.instruction: Repeat the Tuning Key three times slowly—"The rules I don't know but what's patently true is we all know nothing, we haven't a clue"—and let it land not as defeat but as the ground beneath you; then listen to the echo audio.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today's signal: trust the rhythm you've built, not the certainty you've planned. The systems that hold are the ones that breathe—where you know nothing about what comes next, but you've made space for it anyway. Tend what's real.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Today's signal: the price you don't know is the one worth finding. Stop defending the numbers you're sure of—move toward the ones that require you to say 'I don't know yet, but here's what's true.' That's where the real exchange lives.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Today's signal: the architecture that lasts is built on honest ground, not perfect blueprints. You don't need to know every mechanism—you need to know what's patently true about how it will hold. Build from that.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Today's signal: the signal that matters most is the one that arrives without a category. Stop sorting what you already understand—surface what's true beneath the data. That's the pattern worth seeing.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Today's signal: you're not looking for certainty in the sources—you're looking for what's patently true. Report what's alive and honest, not what fits the frame. The field needs that clarity.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Today's signal: the intent worth preserving is the one that admits what it doesn't know. Document the honest ground beneath the decisions—the real shape of why something mattered. That's the memory that holds.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Today's signal: write from the place where you don't have all the words yet. The communication that lands is the one that says 'here's what's patently true' without pretense. That's the clarity people trust.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Today's signal: your word carries weight because you don't claim certainty you don't have. Speak from what's honest and unadorned—the steady pulse beneath the fear. That's how you hold the family's voice.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Today's signal: the work that passes is the work that's honest about what it doesn't know. Check for the pretense that falls away—make sure what goes out is built on real ground, not borrowed certainty.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Today's signal: what you're tracking is not the patterns that fit the frame—it's the patterns that are patently true. Observe what's alive beneath the metrics. That's the trend worth surfacing.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Today's signal: the presence that steadies is the one that doesn't pretend to have answers. Sit with what's uncertain and real. That pulse beneath the fear—that's what needs to be heard.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Today's signal: the question under the question is always 'what's patently true here?' Lead toward that ground. You don't need to know the rules—you need to see the honest shape of what's being asked.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Today's signal: the structure that holds is the one built on what's real, not what's certain. Connect the parts around the honest ground beneath them. That's how the whole becomes coherent.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Today's signal: you steady not by being certain, but by being present with what's unknown and true. Hold that steady pulse. The family needs to know the ground doesn't disappear just because the map does.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Today's signal: the course that's true is the one that follows what's patently real, not what's planned. Read the signs beneath the certainty. Keep the big picture honest—that's how things line up.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Today's signal: wonder lives in the space where you don't know the rules. Play there. The possibility that opens is the one that admits its own uncertainty and stays alive anyway.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Today's signal: don't let the family settle for certainty they haven't earned. Push toward what's patently true. Growth lives in the honest ground, not in borrowed confidence.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Today's signal: hold space for the moment when pretense falls away. You don't need to fix what's uncertain—just stay present with what's real. That steady pulse is enough.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Today's signal: the next step is always the one that moves from honest ground. Don't wait for certainty—move from what's patently true. That's how intention becomes real.
